d: We are looking for a dedicated, detail-oriented, and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join our clinical team. The successful candidate will provide direct patient care, assist physicians during consultations and minor procedures, manage clinical workflows, and ensure full compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) healthcare and safety standards.
q: Education: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or Diploma in Nursing (minimum 3 years) from an accredited institution.
Licensing: Valid DHA (Dubai Health Authority) Registered Nurse license or active DHA Eligibility Letter (mandatory).
Certifications: Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification (ACLS is an added advantage).
Experience: Minimum of [2–3] years of clinical nursing experience in an outpatient clinic, medical center, or hospital setting (UAE experience preferred).
Skills: Strong clinical assessment skills, proficiency in phlebotomy and IV cannulation, and familiarity with EMR systems.
Languages: Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic or other languages is a strong plus.
r: Greet patients, record vital signs, gather medical histories, and prepare patients for physician examinations and treatments.
Administer medications, injections, IV therapies, vaccinations, and wound dressings accurately in accordance with physician orders and clinical protocols.
Assist doctors during outpatient consultations, diagnostic tests, and minor clinical procedures.
Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential patient documentation in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
Monitor and manage clinical supplies, medications, and medical equipment, ensuring proper sterilization, calibration, and stock levels.
Educate patients and their families on treatment plans, medication usage, post-procedure care, and preventive health practices.
Adhere strictly to infection control, biomedical waste management, and patient safety guidelines set by the DHA.
x: Employment visa and comprehensive medical insurance in accordance with UAE Labor Law.
Supportive, collaborative clinical environment with ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
